title: Exercise: Flashing Beacon with TON
oneLiner: Make a lamp flash half a second on, half a second off, using on-delay timers that restart themselves.
keyTakeaway: A timer whose own output resets its input restarts itself; two timers resetting each other, or one timer with its ET compared to a half period, give a steady flash.
explanation:
A flashing beacon is the hello world of PLC timers: no inputs changing, just time. The program has to produce a steady on/off rhythm from on-delay timers, and the trick is making a timer restart itself so the pattern repeats for as long as it's enabled.

The grader watches the lamp for four seconds and measures every on and off period, allowing for the extra scan each timer restart costs.
